turns.content: Paanch hafte pehle layoff ho gaya mera. Poori team gayi, market ka scene tha, performance ka nahi — dimaag se toh pata hai mujhe. Ab woh baat jo main kisi se keh nahi pa raha: main ab bhi roz subah nau baje laptop bag leke ghar se nikalta hoon. Chhe baje tak café. Wife ko nahi pata. Parents aajkal hamare saath hi ruke hain. Kisi ko nahi pata.

Bhai, pehli baat — tune yeh mujhe bataya, iske liye shukriya. Yeh bolna aasan nahi tha, main jaanta hoon.

Aur dusri baat — tujhe judge karne ka koi iraada nahi hai. Kyunki jo tu kar raha hai, woh bohot log karte hain. Tu un sab se protect karna chahta hai — wife, parents — kyunki tujhe lagta hai ki tera kaam hai unka khayal rakhna, unhe tension mein nahi daalna. Yeh kamzori nahi hai, yeh teri fitrat ka hissa hai. Tu care karta hai.

Lekin ek baat seedha bolunga dost ki tarah — **yeh roz ka café wala routine tere andar andar kha raha hai.** Har roz ka jhooth bohot bhaari hota hai. Subah nikalte waqt jo dabav hota hai, café mein jo akelapan hota hai, shaam ko ghar lautke jo nakab pehenta hai — yeh sab ek aisi cheez hai jo tujhe dheere dheere andar se tod rahi hai.

Tu keh raha hai dimaag se samajhta hai ki performance ka issue nahi tha. Par dil abhi maan nahi raha na? Lagta hai jaise tere haath se sab nikal gaya, aur agar sabko pata chala toh... toh kya hoga, yeh soch ke darr lagta hai?

Yeh soch — agar wife ko kisi aur se pata chale toh? Ya parents ko? Woh isliye hurt honge nahi ki tu laid off hua, **isliye ki tu akela lad raha tha aur unhe bata tak nahi.**

Tu tayyar nahi hai abhi bolne ke liye, toh mat bol abhi. Par ek chhota step le — **ek insaan ko bata de.** Wife ho ya koi bahut close dost. Ek insaan. Bas itna.

Aur haan — tu abhi bhi har subah uth ke tayyar ho raha hai, laptop bag utha raha hai, nikal raha hai. Iska matlab hai ki himmat abhi baaki hai. Tu tuta nahi hai. Bas bojh bahut zyada hai, aur akele uthana mushkil hai.

Main yahan hoon. Bolna ho toh bol. 💙

Do hafte mein cousin ki shaadi hai. Teen sau log, aadhe woh rishtedaar jo sabke careers stock market ki tarah track karte hain. Papa meri company ke naam se introduce karte hain — pichli Diwali chacha ko mera package bataya tha, proudly, sach mein proud hoke. Neend nahi aati toh wahi kamra dimaag mein chalta hai.

Bhai, woh kamra jo baar baal chal raha hai dimaag mein — main dekh sakta hoon. Shaadi ka hall, Papa ka chehra, koi puchhe *"kahan ho abhi?"*, aur tu smile karke kuch bole jo sach nahi hai. Aur Papa khade honge paas mein, bilkul genuine pride se.

Woh scene isliye loop mein chal raha hai kyunki tera dil keh raha hai — **yeh jhooth Papa ke saamne bolna sabse mushkil hai.** Baaki sab se manage ho jaaye, par jis insaan ne tere package pe aankhon mein chamak laake chacha ko bataya tha... uske saamne nakab pehen na, woh tere liye almost unbearable hai.

Aur ek sach baat bolunga jo tu shayad sunna nahi chaahta abhi —

**Papa tujhpe proud package ke liye nahi the.** Woh tujhpe proud the kyunki tu mehnat kar raha tha, apne pair pe khada tha, unhe laga unka beta settled hai. Package ek number tha jo unhone share kiya — asli pride tujhme tha. Woh abhi bhi hai. Layoff usko mitata nahi hai.

Par haan — agar shaadi mein woh scene aaya, aur tujhe unke saamne jhooth bolna pade... toh woh chehra tu bahut lamba time tak yaad rakhega. Aur Papa ko agar baad mein pata chale — shaadi ke baad, kisi aur se — toh woh hurt isliye nahi honge ki naukri gayi. **Woh isliye toot jayenge ki beta itna dard jhel raha tha aur humse chhupaya.**

Do hafte hain abhi. Shaadi se pehle ek kaam kar — **Papa se akele mein baat kar.** Sirf Papa se. Yeh mat bol ki *"sabko bata do."* Yeh bol ki —

*"Papa, ek cheez batani hai. Scene thoda kharab hai abhi market ka, poori team gayi. Main handle kar raha hoon, kuch soch ke rakha hai. Bas aapko bata raha hoon kyunki aap se jhooth nahi bol sakta."*

Papa ka reaction tujhe surprise karega. Tujhe lagta hai woh toot jayenge — zyaadatar Indian Papa ek second ke liye chup ho jaate hain, phir bolte hain *"theek hai, dekhte hain."* Unhone bhi struggles dekhe hain apni zindagi mein.

Aur ek practical baat — shaadi mein rishtedaar puchenge toh yeh bol: *"Transition period chal raha hai, kuch options dekh raha hoon."* Yeh jhooth nahi hai, aur kisi ko aur detail dene ka haq nahi hai.

Par asli kaam shaadi se pehle karna hai. **Papa se. Akele mein.**

Tu yeh kar sakta hai. 💙

Kabhi kabhi sochta hoon shaadi skip hi kar doon — bol doon release hai, office ki deadline hai, kuch bhi. Jhooth bolna aasaan hai us se, ki papa ka chehra unke bhaiyon ke saamne badalte hue dekhoon. Bahut galat hai kya yeh? Ek shaam hai, ek bahana, aur main shaadi ki story nahi banunga.

Nahi, galat nahi hai yeh sochna. Tu koi villain nahi hai jo escape plan bana raha hai. Tu ek insaan hai jo thak chuka hai, aur sabse kam dene wala raasta dhoondh raha hai. Yeh samajh mein aata hai.

Par ek minute ruk. Honestly soch —

**Shaadi skip karega toh kya hoga?**

Rishtedaar waise bhi nahi puchenge zyada — woh apne mein busy honge. Papa tujhe miss karenge wahan. Maa puchhegi *"beta kahan hai?"* Aur tu us shaam ghar pe akela baitha hoga — café ka nakab utar ke, ghar ka nakab pehen ke — aur tujhe wahi ghar pe rehke woh poori shaadi dimaag mein chalani padegi jo tu reality mein nahi jhel paaya. Woh zyada kharab hoga.

Aur phir ek aur jhooth maintain karna padega — *"deadline thi"*. Koi puchhega *"kaisa raha?"* toh tu bolna padega *"achha tha, photos dekhi."* Aur yeh cycle chalti rahegi.

Tu notice kar raha hai pattern? **Har jhooth ke baad ek aur jhooth chahiye.** Aur tu already paanch hafte se yeh jhel raha hai. Tu isliye thaka hua hai kyunki roz subah se shaam tak nakab pehenke ghumta hai. Ek aur nakab kya karega?

Yeh sun — tera darr asli hai. Par woh darr jo tujhe sabse zyada dara raha hai — *"Papa ka chehra badalte hue"* — woh tab ka hai jab tu **taanke aur muhn se** kuch galat bolega. **Lekin agar tu shaadi se pehle Papa se ek sach bol de, toh shaadi mein tera kandha halka hoga.** Woh chehra nahi badlega kyunki Papa already jaan chuka hoga. Shaadi mein tu ja sakega — bina nakab ke. Bina darr ke.

Ek shaam ki bahana tujhe ek raat bachayegi. Par ek sach bolna tujhe roz ki nakab se chhutkara dega.

Tu abhi tak sab akele carry kar raha hai. Ek insaan ko bol de. **Shaadi se pehle. Papa ko. Bas itna.**

Tujhe pata hai ki yeh sahi hai. Isliye tu mujhse pooch raha hai — kyunki tu chahta hai koi tujhe roke. 💙

Paison ka aisa hai ki teen mahine nikal jayenge, phir EMI savings khaana shuru kar degi. Khud ko yahi bolta rehta hoon ki offer haath mein aate hi sabko bata dunga — tab woh sirf news hogi, crisis nahi. Yeh jhooth toh nahi hua na? Bas... timing hai? Kabhi yeh logic bilkul solid lagta hai aur kabhi lagta hai ulti aa jayegi.

Bhai, main seedha bolta hoon — kyunki ab tak bohot pyaar se suna, ab ek dost ki tareh bolna chahta hoon.

Tera logic sach hai... **aadha.**

Haan, offer haath mein ho toh delivery aasaan hoti hai. *"Naukri gayi thi, lekin dekho naya offer aa gaya."* Crisis nahi lagegi, news lagegi. Yeh bilkul sahi hai strategically.

**Par problem yeh hai ki tu is logic ko control nahi kar raha — yeh logic tujhe control kar raha hai.**

Kyunki teen hafte pehle yeh tha — *"ek hafte mein kuch hoga."* Ab hai — *"offer aate hi bata dunga."* Agar teen mahine mein offer nahi aaya? Tab bol — *"EMI kaat raha hoon par manage kar lunga, tab bataunga."* Phir? Goalpost shift hote rahega. Aur har roz ka jhooth bhaari hota rahegi.

Tu notice kar — **tu har baar wahi formula use kar raha hai: jhooth ko sach banane ke liye sahi waqt ka intezaar.** Par sahi waqt kabhi nahi aata bhai — kyunki kabhi bhi aur kuch ho sakta hai. *"Abhi appraisal season hai, baad mein bolunga. Abhi Diwali aa rahi hai, baad mein. Abhi Papa ka birthday hai..."*

Aur ek cheez — jo tu bol nahi raha —

**Tera logic solid tab lagta hai jab tu akele sochta hai. Uulti tab aati hai jab tu Papa ka chehra yaad karta hai, ya wife se baat karte waqt zehen mein woh ek sach chhupta hai.**

Woh ulti aana tera gut hai. Teri body bol rahi hai ki yeh raasta galat hai. Aur tu sun raha hai — isliye yahan hai.

Ab ek practical baat — tu sabko bolne ki baat nahi kar raha. **Wife ko bol. Sirf wife ko.**

Kyunki:
- Woh teri partner hai — EMI, savings, dono ka decision uska bhi hai
- Woh tere saath raat ko so rahi hai aur nahi jaanti ki tu roz subah nakab pehenke nikalta hai
- Agar usse baad mein kisi aur se pata chale — trust ka jo tootega woh naukri se zyada lamba jaayega
- Aur sabse zaroori — **tu akele nahi rahega**

Offer aane ka wait mat kar. Kyunki offer ka koi guarantee nahi hai. Par teri shaadi hai, tera ghar hai, tera saamaan hai — yeh abhi hai. Aur woh dono ki zimmedaari hai, sirf teri nahi.

Ek sach. Ek insaan. Aaj nahi toh kal. Par offer se pehle. **Please.** 💙
